name: PAI Word English Core20K V2 integration candidate freeze
scope: isolated V2 candidate full_pack only; no runtime publication
headwords_and_rank: 20,000 frozen in separate canonical Core20K; do not rebuild or rerank

known_exceptions.note: Counts are from historical audit and may overlap. Recompute current flagged counts from frozen shard blobs before making an eligible-row claim.

integration_rules: Treat this exact six-blob snapshot as immutable input; verify each Git blob SHA before import.
Preserve original term/rank, teaching_sense_id and ku_id; reject collisions and missing required fields.
Do not include records with v2_needs_semantic_review=true or question_requires_rebuild=true in study-quiz Runtime. Also exclude explicitly held KU IDs from audit records until resolved.
A clean record may be used for downstream staging integration tests only after automated field/answer validation; passing structural QA alone is not semantic certification.
Do not merge into production Runtime or publish without separate explicit release decision. All later editorial repairs must produce a new versioned manifest, not mutate this frozen reference.
